Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic most recent funding round valuation 2024
Intel Items.facts: Anthropic closed a $30 billion Series G funding round at a $380 billion post-money valuation. The round was led by Coatue and Singapore sovereign wealth fund GIC. Other participants included D. E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ and MGX. The round included a portion of previously announced investments from Microsoft (up to $5 billion) and Nvidia (up to $10 billion). This was the second-biggest private financing round on record for tech at the time.

Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic February 2026 $380 billion funding round Coatue GIC
Intel Items.facts: Anthropic concluded a $30 billion Series G fundraising round with a new valuation of $380 billion post-money, a huge jump from the previous Series F valuation of $183 billion in September 2025. The round was led by Singaporean wealth fund GIC and investment management firm Coatue. Other co-leads included D. E. Shaw Ventures, Peter Thiel's Founders Fund, and Abu Dhabi's MGX. Other significant investors included Accel, General Catalyst, Jane Street, and Qatar Investment Authority. Krishna Rao, Anthropic's CFO, stated the funding reflects incredible demand from customers.

Intel Items.facts: Anthropic raised $30 billion in a Series G funding round at a $380 billion post-money valuation. The round included a portion of investments from Microsoft and Nvidia announced in November. Anthropic was valued at $183 billion five months prior (September 2025) when it raised $13 billion in Series F. The company's run-rate revenue grew to $14 billion. Customers spending over $100,000 annually increased sevenfold over the past year. The round was led by GIC and Coatue. Claude Code has run-rate revenue of $2.5 billion.

Co-leads included Fidelity Management & Research Company and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Run-rate revenue was approximately $1 billion at the start of 2025, reaching over $5 billion by August 2025. The company serves over 300,000 business customers. Claude Code generates over $500 million in run-rate revenue with usage growing more than 10x in three months.

Intel Items.facts: Amazon announced an additional $4 billion investment in Anthropic in November 2024, bringing Amazon's total investment to $8 billion. Amazon remains a minority investor. AWS became Anthropic's primary cloud and training partner. Anthropic will use AWS Trainium and Inferentia chips to train and deploy its largest AI models.
